description: Find the WeShoal web tool that does a task (e.g. "compress a PDF to 200 KB", "remove vocals from a song", "HEIC to JPG", "UK VAT"). Returns tool names, direct URLs and whether it runs free in the browser or uses paid cloud AI. Most tools are free, need no sign-up and keep files on the device.
